name: fvtt-mod-crystalball
description: Crystal Ball: the module is plain ES modules loaded straight from scripts/, with no build step and nothing from here shipping in it. The Seer (seer/) is a Node service run from this package: `npm ci --omit=dev` on the box installs its runtime dependencies alone. This file declares both and the gate (Biome and the unit tests).

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test
